email_body:
Dear Qargo Team,

I am writing to apply for the UI/UX Designer position at Qargo. With a strong foundation in UI design, front-end development, and a passion for creating intuitive, accessible interfaces, I am excited about the opportunity to own and evolve your design system from the ground up.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I build and maintain client websites using WordPress and Elementor, ensuring responsive and user-friendly designs. Previously, as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, I developed and optimized features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript, honing my skills in creating clean, functional UI components.

I am proficient in Figma and have experience with design systems like Ant Design and Material Design. I am comfortable working with dense, complex applications and am eager to apply my HTML/CSS knowledge to bridge design and development. I am also familiar with AI tools, including Claude Code, to streamline design workflows.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Ghent, and am fluent in English. I am eager to bring my proactive ownership and customer-focused mindset to Qargo.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear Qargo Team,

I am excited to apply for the UI/UX Designer position at Qargo. As a designer with a strong UI focus and a technical background, I am drawn to the opportunity to build and own a design system from the ground up, shaping the visual experience of your Transport Management Platform.

My journey has been a blend of design and development. As a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, I crafted user interfaces for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript, learning to balance aesthetics with functionality. More recently, at Episto, I have been building and maintaining client websites, ensuring they are responsive, accessible, and visually consistent. This hands-on experience has given me a deep appreciation for the importance of design systems in creating cohesive, scalable products.

I am proficient in Figma and have studied established design systems like Ant Design and Material Design. I understand the principles of accessibility, hierarchy, and usability that are crucial for dense, complex applications. My HTML/CSS knowledge allows me to communicate effectively with engineers and ensure that designs are implemented accurately.

I am also comfortable using AI tools, including Claude Code, to accelerate prototyping and design workflows. I am eager to work closely with product owners and engineers, and to engage directly with customers to inform design decisions.

Based in Zwijndrecht, near Ghent, I am ready to bring my proactive ownership and collaborative spirit to Qargo. I am fluent in English and am currently improving my Dutch.

Thank you for considering my application. I am enthusiastic about the possibility of contributing to your team and growing with Qargo.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
